show.title: A Masked Ball
show.synopsis: Verdi's opera, inspired by the assassination of King Gustav III of Sweden: a fortune teller tells King Gustavus that his best friend's wife, Amelia, returns his love, and warns that the next man to shake his hand will kill him. Philipp Stölzl's new production for Royal Ballet and Opera, sung in Italian with English surtitles.
